name: TACO Detect
description: TACO (Trash Annotations in Context): litter detection in the wild across woods, roads and beaches. 1500 images, 4784 instances, 28 supercategory classes (the 60 fine classes are extremely long-tailed, so the 28 supercategories are used for usable detection). Content-deduplicated, with filenames batch-prefixed to prevent per-batch index collisions. Source: Proenca, P.F. and Simoes, P., 'TACO: Trash Annotations in Context for Litter Detection', arXiv:2003.06975, 2020. Archive: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3587843 under CC-BY-4.0. Segmentation masks converted to YOLO bounding boxes. Original academic release.
